claim: McLaren Vale's geology map identifies some nineteen distinct geologies across a small region
because: Nineteen is the number of proposed McLaren Vale districts (McLaren Vale Districts Working Group), not geologies. The 2010 Geology of the McLaren Vale Wine Region map (Fairburn, Olliver, Preiss, White) shows more than 40 geological units, and the regional body now says more than 55 unique geologies.
fix: McLaren Vale's geology map identifies more than 40 geological units (the region now counts over 55) across a small region, grouped into some nineteen proposed districts, and it is that map, not the GI line, that the Scarce Earth single-site Shiraz project is built on.
